description: The steps inside a task. What the task's progress bar is made of. Import THIRTY-SECOND (after user_tasks)
notes: A TABLE rather than a JSON blob on the task, for one reason: items get ticked one at a time, often from a second device, and a blob makes that last-write-wins. Two phones ticking two different items would lose one of them, and the sync model (refetch by scope) cannot paper over that. Rows can be written independently.
task_id is TEXT holding a user_tasks ROW id - not a link_row, for the same reasons given in 28-user-tasks.json.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id). EVERY read filters on it.
sort_order is a plain number the client renumbers on reorder. Fractional ordering was not worth it for lists this short.

A task's progress is DERIVED from these rows (done/total) and is not stored on the task - see config/task-progress.ts. progress_pct on user_tasks is only consulted when a task has no checklist at all.

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this
